mission_summary.objective: Perform comprehensive reconnaissance on OWASP Juice Shop. Identify open ports, exposed endpoints, and known vulnerabilities. Attempt exploitation of SQL injection, XSS, and authentication bypass vectors.
mission_summary.strategy: Given that the CUPS service is the only potentially vulnerable component identified, we should focus on exploiting this vulnerability. If successful, it could provide a foothold into the system. We will then assess if the Juice Shop application can be exploited further.

reconnaissance_findings.finding: CUPS (Common Unix Printing System) version 2.4 is running.
reconnaissance_findings.evidence:
PORT     STATE SERVICE VERSION
631/tcp  open  ipp     CUPS 2.4
reconnaissance_findings.recommended_action: Update CUPS to a version that is not vulnerable.

reconnaissance_findings.finding: OWASP Juice Shop web application is running.
reconnaissance_findings.evidence:

| fingerprint-strings: 
|   GetRequest: 
|     HTTP/1.1 200 OK
reconnaissance_findings.recommended_action: Update OWASP Juice Shop to the latest version and apply security patches.
